Chapter One

The Man Behind
the Screen

My story is still being written.

I'm Sakib Miya, a creator and aspiring data analyst from Nepal. I'm fascinated by technology, the stories hidden inside data, and the process of turning ideas into something real.

From cleaning messy datasets and exploring business problems to experimenting with websites and digital content, I enjoy learning by building.

I'm not claiming to have everything figured out. I'm here to develop my skills, challenge myself, and create work that reflects how far curiosity and consistency can take a person.

  • Data analytics: SQL, Python, Excel, Power BI
  • Building & designing websites
  • Content creation & digital branding
  • Technology, gaming & AI tools

Long term, I want to keep growing my technical skills, build impressive projects, and pursue opportunities in technology and data — possibly in Germany.

The journey is only beginning.

Quick-Draw Shootout

How to play

  1. Hit Start or press Space. You have 30 seconds.
  2. Shoot targets by clicking or tapping them — or press the number key 1–9 shown on each target.
  3. Each hit is 10 pts plus a combo bonus. Gold targets are worth 30.
  4. Missing a shot or letting a target escape resets your combo.
  5. Press R to restart any time. Your best score is saved on this device.
